newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL-Trelleborg H1 profit seen 2.2 blnSKR.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Trelleborg H1 profit seen 2.2 blnSKR.

text.p: Swedish mining and rubber group Trelleborg was expected to post a profit after financial items of 2.16 billion crowns for the first half of 1997, a Reuters poll of nine analysts showed on Thursday.
The forecast included a capital gain of about 1.5 billion crowns from selling off shares in mining unit Boliden, now listed in Toronto.
"We will release the exact capital gain in the half year report," said Gertrud Andersson, economic head at Trelleborg.
Boliden's result will be included in Trelleborg's report as usual.
Forecasts for the half year profit varied between 2.05 billion and 2.38 billion crowns including the capital gain.
Last year the first half profit was 657 million crowns.
For the full year analysts forecast the profit after financial items at 2.79 billion crowns including the capital gain against 1.02 billion crowns a year ago.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aros, Carnegie, CI Nordic, Den Danske Bank, Den Norske Bank, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, Kleinwort Benson, and Matteus.
Trelleborg will release its half year report on August 19.
